integrity: Proof uses a self-contained exhaustive finite-game verifier plus symbolic interval deductions. No external independent certification is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Exactly three agents, five goods, one equal spike per agent, adversarial per-agent frequency predictions, every-path EFX; not a general-horizon result. Publication priority still requires external review.
title: A sharp five-good online EFX minimax law for three one-spike agents
